title: Fix MaintenanceDiffService unbounded diff + crash risk
description:
Fix MaintenanceDiffService unbounded diff + crash risk (Council-refined)

Source: memorysmith-diffservice-audit-26-07-19-01-29-01.md

Problem: `BuildUnifiedDiff` uses an O(n*m) DP table and recursive backtrack that can trigger StackOverflowException and crash process. Convert to iterative backtrack and add input-size guard.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add input-size guard (configurable) and fail with validation error for oversized inputs
- Convert recursive backtrack to iterative algorithm with explicit stack
- Add unit test with truncated input to assert graceful failure (no process crash)

Effort: 1d
